description: Kings of the Card Arena: a turn-based card battler with live PvP duels over SignalR, boss fights and a Gold Shop, built with Clean Architecture on .NET 10 and deployed to Azure on every merge.

title: Word Search Fun
description: A word search game for Android with four difficulty levels and four game modes, built in C# with Unity. First released on the Google Play Store and the Amazon Appstore in 2012.
